commitments.detail: Email collection must be disabled in the survey platform launch settings before the survey goes live.
All existing test responses must be deleted before any student data are gathered.
Explicit written consent must be obtained from all respondents due to inclusion of sensitive data questions (mental-health treatment and immigration status).
Research responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage.
All research responses must be deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The survey must be capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents.
Dissemination is permitted only at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
All operating conditions will be recorded by Dr. Holt as part of the final authorization.
